package: @astryxdesign/lab

# SelectableCardGroup

Use it for a choice among a few rich options shown as cards: a plan, an appearance, a layout. One choice gives users the radio-group keyboard and the position they expect; use `multiple` when several cards can be on.

**Import:** `import {SelectableCardGroup} from '@astryxdesign/lab';`

## Best Practices

- **Do:** Give every card a `label` that names its option; it is the radio or checkbox name screen readers speak.
- **Do:** Start a single choice with a value when the product has a sensible default, so the tab stop lands on it.
- **Don't:** Put buttons or links inside the cards; the whole card is the radio or checkbox target.
- **Don't:** Use it for navigation or actions; use ClickableCard for those.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `label` | `string` | - | The group's visible label and accessible name. **(required)** |
| `selectionMode` | `'single' \| 'multiple'` | `'single'` | `single`: a radio group with one value. `multiple`: a group of checkboxes with any number of values. |
| `value` | `string \| null \| ReadonlyArray<string>` | - | The chosen value (`single`, `null` while none is chosen) or values (`multiple`). **(required)** |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void \| (value: string[]) => void` | - | Called with the chosen value (`single`) or the new list of values (`multiple`). **(required)** |
| `isLabelHidden` | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the label visually; it still names the group. |
| `description` | `string` | - | Helper text under the label, linked to the group. |
| `htmlName` | `string` | - | The name the group's value is submitted under. The radios group by a generated name. Defaults to a generated one. |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables every card; they stay focusable and announce disabled. |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | `horizontal` wraps the cards in rows; `vertical` stacks them. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | SelectableCardGroupItem cards. Each takes a `value` and the SelectableCard props other than isSelected and onChange. **(required)** |
| `containerXstyle` | `StyleXStyles` | - | StyleX styles for the Field box around the label, description and cards (margins, positioning, sizing). The group composes Field, so it takes no root xstyle, className or style. |
| `containerClassName` | `string` | - | Class name for the Field box. Same targeting as containerXstyle. |
| `containerStyle` | `CSSProperties` | - | Inline styles for the Field box. Same targeting as containerXstyle. |

## Theming

| Component class | Preferred data attributes | Props | States |
|-----------------|---------------------------|-------|--------|
| `astryx-selectable-card-group` | `data-orientation`, `data-selection-mode` | orientation, selectionMode | - |

Override in defineTheme:
```ts
components: {
  'selectable-card-group': {
    base: { /* CSS properties */ },
    'orientation:value': { /* variant-specific */ },
  },
}
```
